Name: Buff_Mana_Surge
Description: Increases spell damage by 1% for 5 seconds for every 100 maximum mana.

Name: Buff_Warhound
Description: A temporary minion that taunts enemies and deals damage.

Name: Buff_Tactical_Advantage
Description: Increases movement speed and damage by 35% after using a movement ability.

Name: Buff_Plague
Description: At 10 stacks, spreads all DoTs to nearby enemies.

Name: Buff_Demonic_Rage
Description: When your health falls below 25%, you become immune to crowd control and deal 100% more damage for 10 seconds.

Name: Buff_Sanctified_Power
Description: A stack gained every 10 seconds. When an attack is blocked, all of your skills are instantly refreshed.

Name: Buff_Temporal_Flux
Description: A stack gained every 30 seconds. When a skill is used, it is cast a random number of times.

Name: Buff_Void
Description: At 10 stacks, your next ability costs no mana and deals 100% more damage.

Name: Buff_Death
Description: Every 10 seconds, when a skill is used, it has a 25% chance to instantly kill an enemy below 50% health.

Name: Buff_Spellslinger
Description: Each stack reduces the mana cost of your abilities by 10%.

Name: Buff_Dervish
Description: Increases your attack speed for melee attacks by 10% per stack.

Name: Buff_Famished
Description: Increases all of your leech by 5%.

Name: Buff_Warzone_Control_Points
Description: Holding these provides strategic advantages.

Name: Buff_Divine_Aegis
Description: Gain a divine shield when below 50% HP, reducing all damage taken by 75%.

Name: Buff_Commander
Description: All nearby allies gain 20% increased stats.

Name: Buff_Chaotic_Barrier
Description: Temporarily grants a random buff when attacked.

Name: Buff_The_Ascended
Description: A powerful buff granted to all nearby enemies when this enemy is killed.

Name: Buff_Feasting
Description: This enemy gains a stack of "Feast" every time it is hit, and for every stack, its attack speed is increased.

Name: Debuff_Temporal_Debt
Description: A stacking debuff that freezes all your cooldowns for 5 seconds when it reaches 10 stacks.

Name: Debuff_Withered_Touch
Description: An effect that reduces player damage output and mana/energy shield for a short duration.

Name: Debuff_Haunting
Description: A debuff applied by a spectral copy of an enemy that reduces all of a player's resistances.

Name: Debuff_Wither
Description: A debuff that, at 10 stacks, reduces the player's movement and attack speed.

Name: Debuff_Infernal_Brand
Description: A stacking debuff that explodes at 5 stacks, dealing a large amount of fire damage to the player.

Name: Debuff_Abyssal_Aura

Name: Debuff_Starforged
Description: A stacking debuff that reduces the player's damage and increases the damage they take.

Name: Debuff_Nullifying
Description: A debuff that removes a single, random buff from the player.

Name: Debuff_Echoing
Description: A stacking debuff that reduces the player's damage and movement speed.

Name: Debuff_Reality_Bender
Description: An effect that inflicts a random debuff on the player.

Name: Debuff_The_Deceiver
Description: A debuff applied to the player when an illusion is hit.

Name: Debuff_Manic
Description: An aura of chaos that causes all nearby enemies to deal more damage but also take more damage.

Name: Debuff_Toxic_Trail
Description: Enemies leave behind a poison cloud that applies a poison debuff.

Name: Debuff_Battle_Cry
Description: A terrifying shout that reduces the player's resistances or armor for 5 seconds.

Name: Debuff_Contagion
Description: A debuff that mirrors DoTs and debuffs back onto the player.

Name: Debuff_Starving_Aura
Description: An aura that reduces healing and health regeneration effects by 50%.

Name: Debuff_Final_Curse
Description: Upon death, this enemy curses the player for 5 seconds, causing them to take damage when using abilities.

Name: Debuff_Shared_Pain
Description: A debuff that distributes damage taken across nearby allies.

Name: Debuff_Soul_Tether
Description: A debuff that transfers a portion of damage taken to the player as health degeneration over time.

Name: Debuff_Touch_of_Nothing
Description: When a player gains a buff, a stack of this debuff is consumed to negate that buff completely.

Description: Applied by the Infernal Brand and Hellfire Aura enemy modifiers.
